creator: Alexander Terp
description:
VISION.md Phase 0 sizes it at a week and calls it the most-requested format and a current disqualifier ("no YAML? not for ops").

Parked on a tension worth resolving before building it: the review of ~195 real scripts and 41k invocations surfaced **zero** YAML demand. The vision's case rests on GitHub issue #72 and on ops perception; the corpus's case is silence. Those aren't contradictory - the corpus can only contain what Rad could already express - but a week is too much to spend without knowing which signal is load-bearing.

If it does get built, the vision's own note applies: TOML and CSV follow only as demand appears, and each is real work rather than a checkbox.
title: YAML parsing
